chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 595: Ji Ning Plans His Hunt in the Zhuanshui Territories
chapter_meta_description: With the Five Treasures Sword Art under his belt, Ji Ning gets the green light from Patriarch Subhuti to hunt Seamless Gate Empyrean Gods. Shaoyan Chou's sixteen clones are marked.
og_description: Ji Ning receives a detailed power distribution map from his master and targets the Seamless Gate's Empyrean Gods in the Dongxuan Major World.
twitter_description: Ji Ning turns from student to assassin, using a top-secret intel scroll to locate his enemy’s sixteen clones.

lore_anchors.definition: The five legendary rulers (Emperors) who unified the human race in ancient times. In Desolate Era, they command vast territories and are second only to the Three Sovereigns in power.
The hated True Immortal enemy of the Ji clan; a master of clones who has eighteen scattered across the Three Realms. He is the ancestor of the Shaoyan clan that destroyed the Yuchi clan.
A major world under the rule of the ancient Human Emperor Zhuanxu, currently a hotbed for Seamless Gate infiltration with nine Empyrean Gods and True Immortals stationed there.
The entire domain ruled by Emperor Zhuanxu, consisting of thirty-nine major worlds.
The domain ruled by Daofather Crimsonbright, a smaller territory compared to those of the Human Five Emperors.
A hidden major world within the Aquatic Palace, refined and fully mastered by Ji Ning. He uses it to store his allies and teleport them anywhere.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. At the fourth level, it can silently envelop an entire major world.
A general term for the supreme, often Divine Ability-level shapeshifting techniques that allow a cultivator to change their form and aura at will.
